title: Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2
synopsis: Inti Creates’ 8-bit-style sequel — retained as Limited Run Games’ #98 Nintendo Switch physical edition.

catalog.publisher: Inti Creates · physical edition by Limited Run Games
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · Limited Run Games edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case · Limited Run Games #98 edition

curatorNotes:
Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2 returns to Inti Creates’ 8-bit-style action with new playable companions joining Zangetsu.

It released digitally on July 10, 2020, including on Nintendo Switch. Limited Run Games produced its Switch physical edition as Switch Limited Run #98 in 2021.

The filing follows Curse of the Moon in the Bloodstained lineage.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Switch Limited Run #98, Limited Run Games’ physical edition of Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon 2.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Released digitally on July 10, 2020. Limited Run Games issued the Switch physical edition as Switch Limited Run #98 in 2021, in standard, Classic, and convention-exclusive editions.
preservation.availability: Limited Run Games’s physical edition was a limited production and now circulates through the secondary market. The digital Switch edition was issued separately on the Nintendo eShop.
